title: Elastic Bite: cycle allocation and surgical-slice decommitment protocol
creator: Riya Patel
description:
Problem: We frequently hit mid-cycle resource pinch points that force blunt scope cuts or emergency reassignments. Existing guidance (reserve lanes, buffer bands) helps but is often coarse-grained and manual.

Proposal: Introduce an "Elastic Bite" allocation model + a Surgical Slice decommitment protocol. The model preserves a small number of fractional ‘bites’ (micro-allocation tokens) per role and a transparent prioritization ladder so PMs, Eng leads and Design can quickly commit and revoke sub-slices of scope without disrupting cross-team dependencies.

Goals:
- Reduce all-hands mid-cycle reassignments by 40% (measured by time people are moved off their core commitments).
- Cut scope-trim decision latency from 3 days to <24 hours for non-critical slices.
- Maintain OKR delivery confidence by protecting critical path lanes with immutable core commits and routing emergent work to elastic bites.

Scope: Define policy, tooling signals, acceptance criteria, rollout playbook, and one pilot with Infra.Core and Console teams. Integrations: Redwood Console capacity dashboard and Slack triage channel workflow.

Out-of-scope: Full org-level capacity marketplace (future initiative).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Documented policy that defines: core commit tiers, bite token sizes by role, trigger thresholds for using/recalling bites.
2) Console dashboard card (read-only) showing bite utilization per team and burn rate.
3) Pilot run across 2 pods for one cycle with retrospective and measured metrics.
4) Runbook for PM/Eng/Design to request and revoke bites with Slack + ticket updates.
5) Stakeholder signoff from Eng, Design, and People & Ops.
tasks: Finalize policy draft and circulate for review (PM + Eng + Design)
Define bite sizing matrix by role and work type (feature, bug, spike)
Add bite usage telemetry to Console (grafana panel + heatmap)
Implement Slack triage slash-command /bite-request that creates a ticket stub and notifies owners
Pilot in infra-core and console pods for Cycle 2026-W11
Run pilot retrospective and produce decision memo (keep/iterate/abort)
decisions: Prefer soft-freeze + micro-decommit over blunt scope removal for non-critical slices
Bite tokens are fractional (0.1-0.5 FTE equivalent) and time-boxed to no longer than 10 working days unless explicitly extended
Core commit lanes (critical path) are immutable during the cycle unless executive escalation
When two teams contest the same bite, priority goes to customer-impacted work as measured by measurable criteria (incidents, SLA risk, revenue pipeline)
rollout_plan: Week 0: policy finalization and stakeholder signoff. Week 1: Console dashboard card and Slack workflow implemented. Week 2: Pilot kickoff with two pods; leadership daily standups for first 5 days. End of cycle: retrospective + metrics review and decision memo. If pilot meets success thresholds (see metrics), extend model org-wide as opt-in for next cycle.
metrics: Scope-trim decision time (target: <24 hours for bites)
Bite utilization rate (target healthy use: 15-35% of available bites)
OKR delivery confidence score from stakeholders (target: no net decline)
Number of contested bites escalated to execs (target: <=1 per pilot cycle)
